description: For injective g, the Bernstein map equals f on C; outside C its argument lies in the image of g and g(h(a)) = a.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.bernstein_map_spec.{u, v} {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (f : α → β) (g : β → α)
  (hg : Function.Injective g) :
  (∀ a ∈ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.bernsteinRegion f g, Lemmatheca.SetTheory.bernsteinMap f g hg a = f a) ∧
    ∀ a ∉ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.bernsteinRegion f g, a ∈ Set.range g ∧ g (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.bernsteinMap f g hg a) = a
